title.en: Caring veterinary team led by Dr. Weeks

text.en: Most pet owners praise Dr. Weeks and the veterinary staff on Mainland Drive for their warmth, punctuality, and attentive care over many years. However, one prospective client criticised the front desk receptionist as uncaring during a phone enquiry regarding a senior dog and an upfront appointment deposit.

title.en: Comforting environment for dogs and cats

text.en: Reviewers note that their dogs, cats, and foster pets are treated gently during routine check-ups and boarding stays. Owners mention that Dr. Weeks takes time to help animals feel safe in the exam room, and boarding clients appreciate receiving photo updates that show their dogs settled and well cared for.

title.en: Dependable dental, surgical, and routine care

text.en: Long-term clients report positive outcomes across a range of procedures, including dental cleanings, spay and neuter surgeries, and ongoing feline and canine healthcare. While one cat owner remarked that visits can be somewhat pricey, they emphasised that the clinic consistently delivers thorough medical care.

q.en: What veterinary procedures does Pet Medical Center of San Antonio perform?

a.en: The clinic provides wellness exams, vaccinations, dental prophylaxis, spay and neuter procedures, soft-tissue surgery, and diagnostic imaging.

q.en: Does Pet Medical Center of San Antonio offer dog boarding?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention boarding their dogs at the clinic, including last-minute reservations with photo updates from the staff.

q.en: Is a deposit required when booking a new patient appointment?

a.en: One reviewer noted being asked for a $70 upfront deposit over the phone when scheduling a first-time appointment.
